summary: Join our Effective Negotiation Skills for Leaders course. Learn essential strategies to improve your negotiation tactics and lead with confidence and success.
lede: Negotiation skills training helps leaders and other professionals reach workable agreements while protecting important working relationships. It is designed for people who influence decisions or manage significant organizational outcomes, helping them prepare with stakeholder and bargaining analysis, uncover counterpart interests through questioning, and shape trade-offs into collaborative agreements. The syllabus also covers conflict styles, virtual negotiations, power imbalances, and techniques for resolving deadlocks.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who must influence others without direct authority and those responsible for high-value organizational outcomes.
modules: Negotiating in the Digital and Virtual Age
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in a role involving stakeholder management, procurement, or team leadership. Familiarity with basic business communication is required. No prior formal negotiation training is necessary as the course covers foundations before moving to intermediate strategies.
